name: Romesco Sauce
siboNotes: Traditional romesco contains garlic which is high in fructans. Use garlic-infused oil version or make without garlic for better SIBO tolerance.
preparationTips: Make homemade version using garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic
Check ingredient lists carefully as commercial versions often contain onion powder
Store homemade version in refrigerator for up to 1 week
Can be frozen in ice cube trays for portion control
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in vitamin C from red peppers
Contains healthy fats from nuts and olive oil
Good source of vitamin E and antioxidants
